nodes.label: Altruvex Design Principles (Law Layer)
nodes.rationale: The codified perception/typography/color/spacing knowledge base the site is audited against — why, and what must hold. Numbers are heuristics, not citations. Every rule declares a script scope (latin-only rules never applied to Arabic); conflicts with the token layer are adjudicated in a change table, never silently.

nodes.label: T1 — Weight Hierarchy Needs Real Distance
nodes.rationale: Build weight hierarchy from steps of ≥200; a 100-unit gap is invisible at body sizes in most variable fonts. Hard-rule.

nodes.label: T3 — Non-Linear Modular Scale
nodes.rationale: Derive the type scale from a ratio (Major Third ×1.25 anchored at 16px), not taste-picked sizes; fluid clamps fine if endpoints sit on the scale.

nodes.label: T5 — Line Height by Role
nodes.rationale: Reading text loose (Latin 1.5–1.6), display tight (1.1–1.25). Arabic-variant: body 1.8–2.0, headings 1.25–1.35 — never copy Latin leading to Arabic.

nodes.label: T6 — Line Length (Measure)
nodes.rationale: Cap reading text: Latin 50–75 CPL, sweet spot ~66, hard ceiling 80 — long lines cause return-sweep errors. Arabic verified by words-per-line (~8–12) in Vazirmatn. Hard-rule.

nodes.label: T8 — All-Caps Is a Label Treatment
nodes.rationale: Caps only for short labels (≤3–4 words); running caps erase word-shape landmarks. Latin-only — Arabic has no case; the eyebrow drops transform and tracking in RTL.

nodes.label: T9 — Tracking Inverts Across the Display Threshold
nodes.rationale: Small text tracks slightly open, display slightly tight. Latin-only: connected Arabic script must have letter-spacing: 0 at every size (enforced !important in globals.css).

nodes.label: T12 — Typeface Signal Matches the Claim
nodes.rationale: Letterform genre chosen by the message: Outfit = clarity/confidence, Inter = neutral reading, Geist Mono = engineering signal, serif italic (Highlight) = craft/restraint. Arabic falls back to weight contrast — Arabic italics are not a real convention.

nodes.label: C2 — HSL Lightness Is Not Luminance
nodes.rationale: Never reason about contrast from HSL channel values; perception follows CIELAB-like curves. Verify by measured WCAG contrast, not channel math. Hard-rule.

nodes.label: C4 — Structure Must Survive Greyscale
nodes.rationale: Build hierarchy in greyscale first; color may reinforce rank, never create it. The site's mostly-mono doctrine is this rule. Hard-rule.

nodes.label: C8 — Dark Mode Drops Chroma, Lifts Tone
nodes.rationale: Dark backgrounds amplify perceived saturation: derive dark variants by keeping hue, reducing chroma ~20–30%, lifting tone; verify contrast after. Heuristic — adapted in the reconciliation to a chroma cap.

nodes.label: C9 — Token Architecture: Primitive → Semantic → System
nodes.rationale: Every color routed through the three-layer token chain; components never touch primitives or raw hex. Verified by grepping components for color literals (must be zero). Hard-rule.

nodes.label: C10 — Functional Hue Semantics Drive Assignment
nodes.rationale: Blue = trust/authority, warm high-chroma = action/urgency, green = positive/confirmation; site mapping blue world = brand/trust, orange = action/CTA/pricing, green = proof/shipped. Cultural context verified for the Arab-market audience.

nodes.label: C11 — Semantic Colors Signal State, Never Decorate
nodes.rationale: Success/warning/error tokens only for genuine state; approving color for emphasis comes from the color world, not --success. Hard-rule.

nodes.label: C12 — Contrast Floors and the AAA Target
nodes.rationale: AA everywhere (body ≥4.5:1, large text/UI ≥3:1), design toward AAA (7:1) where the aesthetic allows; all scenes including inverted and tinted bands. Hard-rule.

nodes.label: CI1 — Minimum Target Size 44px
nodes.rationale: Every interactive element gets a ≥44px effective hit target — tap errors are target-size errors (Fitts); a smaller visual can carry a larger hit area. Hard-rule; adapted to coarse pointers only in the reconciliation.

nodes.label: CI6 — Form Mechanics
nodes.rationale: Single column of grouped labeled fields, real-time inline validation at the field on blur/submit, progress indication on multi-step flows. Hard-rule.

nodes.label: CI8 — Radius Is a System and a Voice
nodes.rationale: All radii derive from one base; nested radii shrink (inner = outer − padding); the base is a deliberate brand-voice choice — very low reads precision/authority, large reads consumer-friendly. Hard-rule (nesting math) + judgment (voice).

nodes.label: CI9 — Elevation: Edges First, Two-Layer Shadows, Few Levels
nodes.rationale: Depth defined by edges first, confirmed by a two-layer shadow: soft directional key grows with height, tight ambient contact decays as elevation rises; ~5 levels suffice.

nodes.label: CI10 — Glass Has Five Parameters
nodes.rationale: Glass surfaces specified along light, refraction, depth, dispersion, frost — with a reduced-transparency fallback.

nodes.label: M2 — Anticipation Before Meaningful Reveals
nodes.rationale: Precede a meaningful reveal with a small counter-movement (~4–8% of travel, 15–20% of duration) so attention arrives before the motion; without it the reveal feels abrupt. Not for micro-hovers.

nodes.label: M3 — Motion Respects Capability and Preference
nodes.rationale: Gate all non-essential motion on prefers-reduced-motion, pointer capability, and constrained devices; the base interaction must work with motion off. Hard-rule.

nodes.label: P8 — Jakob's Law: Innovate the Value, Not the Interface
nodes.rationale: Keep interface conventions users carry from the rest of the web; spend novelty on content and craft, not on relearning costs. Each deviation from convention needs a defended reason.

nodes.label: S2 — Columns: 12 / 8 / 4
nodes.rationale: 12-column desktop grid collapsing to 8 tablet / 4 mobile; grid type chosen by job. Deferred to a guidance heuristic for new sections in the reconciliation — retrofitting is a layout rewrite with no identified defect.

nodes.label: S8 — Icon Geometry
nodes.rationale: Consistent 24px bounding box, 2px trim, even 2px strokes on the pixel grid (Lucide default conforms); shape mass compensated; directional icons mirror in RTL.
